audit.whatIsWrong: Only the level-6 row disagrees with the mirror: both layers give it to Karma at 7/10, while the mirror's final chart is Karma / Skill / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius. whys[5] and whys[6] also claim Karma reclaims first item and 2+ items while their side fields say Darius.
audit.why: Karma has no dash, and Apprehend (535 range, 26s at rank 1) pulls through minions; a first-item Darius closes the range her poke depends on.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Darius as a matched pair; whys[5] and whys[6] rewritten so the prose agrees with the Darius rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is the generic 'no new ultimate at 6' line and rates the row 7/10 for Karma.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1 so Karma has no level-6 spike, while Noxian Guillotine (120/100/80s) deals true damage scaled on Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes on a kill.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named as Darius's spike at 4/10 for Karma, matching the mirror's 6/10 on his side.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and late both say Darius 'has no dash to close on a ranged caster'. Noxian Guillotine explicitly leaps to an enemy champion.
audit.why: A player told he has no gap-closer at two items will stand at kiting distance with Hemorrhage stacked and be executed from 460 range.
audit.corrected: Distance is not safety while Hemorrhage is stacked — Noxian Guillotine leaps to you and its damage scales with the stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'add anti-heal early into his sustain' without naming the source.
audit.why: The healing is Decimate (Q), and only on the blade portion against champions — that is what an extended trade turns on.

edits.after: He layers Hemorrhage and empowered Decimate the instant Apprehend lands — stay outside 535.

edits.before: This is where the lane flips to you. Once your first AP/haste item lands, RQ poke and Mantra uptime spike, and by 2+ items your Inner Flame range plus E Inspire's move speed let you kite the radius of his E pull entirely — he has no dash to close the gap a ranged caster opens. Chip him from distance, W-tether to root and peel if he forces a wall, and never let him pin you against terrain for the grab. Use your roam and enchant value to win elsewhere on the map — the longer the game, the more his stat-check melee identity falls behind your range and tempo.

Chip him from range, tether and peel if he forces a wall, and never let him pin you against terrain for the grab. Use your roam and enchant value to win elsewhere — the side lane stays his.

notes: The 'he has no dash' claim appeared twice and was the most dangerous error on the page — Noxian Guillotine is a 460-range leap. Both instances fixed. Level 1 stays with Karma per the mirror's explicit reasoning (Mantra needs no skill point), even though whys[0] concedes Darius has the stronger level 1; the mirror decided that row and I did not fight it. Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset on a 5s cooldown — the wind-up, not the cast, is the step-back tell; it is not stated anywhere on the page and there was no in-band slot to add it without displacing a better fact, so flagging it here.
